message.content: The pain is in my upper left side, right under my ribs. It started off mild about eight days ago, and I thought it was just a stomach bug, but it hasn't gotten any better and is now worse with nausea and vomiting. I don't really know how to rate the pain on a scale, and it didn't start after a specific meal or drinking alcohol. It just feels constant. I don't recall it traveling anywhere else.
